preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in A) and all(c.islower() for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B consist only of lowercase Latin letters.
The lengths of A and B are positive integers between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
A and B are the second and third lines of stdin, respectively, after reading n and m.

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and (int(stdout) == max(4 * len(lcs) - len(C) - len(D) for C in substrings(A) for D in substrings(B) for lcs in [longest_common_subsequence(C, D)]))
postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximal similarity score S(C, D) = 4 * LCS(C, D) - |C| - |D| over all pairs of substrings (C, D) where C is a substring of A and D is a substring of B.
The output is always a non-negative integer, as similarity score cannot be negative.
